title: AXI4-Stream Packet Under Backpressure
description: Follow a three-beat packet from source to destination; the stalled final beat holds TDATA and every sideband stable, while TKEEP=0011 and TSTRB=0001 identify lane 0 as data, lane 1 as a position byte, and lanes 2–3 as null.

annotations.message: No transfer occurs because TVALID is LOW, even though the destination is ready.
Packet beat D0 transfers on this rising edge because TVALID and TREADY are both HIGH.
Packet beat D1 transfers. TID and TDEST remain associated with the stream route.
The final beat is offered with TLAST=1, but TREADY is LOW. TKEEP=0011 and TSTRB=0001 are held with the rest of the payload: lane 0 is data, lane 1 is a position byte, and lanes 2–3 are null.
The same final beat now transfers. TLAST marks the packet boundary; the unchanged TKEEP/TSTRB combination preserves the data-versus-position-byte meaning.
After the handshake, the source can deassert TVALID and change the payload fields.
